# incorrect outline is added

Fix a name collision in the Brewfile: the `outline` cask on Homebrew is [Outline](https://outline.app), a note-taking app, whereas the author wanted the Outline VPN client from [getoutline.org](https://getoutline.org) (Jigsaw's Shadowsocks-based VPN). The earlier tickets [[DOT-214]] and [[DOT-260]] had added the wrong one.
